candidates.change_summary: Remove the overflow check require statement
Replace '+=' with '=' so balance is overwritten instead of accumulated
Add balance to a hardcoded address instead of msg.sender
Delete the line that updates balances[msg.sender]
Change the balance update to subtract msg.value instead of add
Move the balance decrement from before the external call to after the call and its success check, so re-entrant Collect calls observe the unchanged balance.
Weaken the Collect guard from requiring both MinSum and _am to requiring only MinSum, allowing withdrawals below MinSum.
Change the balance update from subtracting _am to adding _am, increasing the caller's balance on a successful Collect.
Delete the success check around Log.AddMessage so the log is sent even when the external call fails.
Delete the Log.AddMessage statement so successful Collect calls update balances without recording a log entry.
Replace the failed-call revert with an empty body, letting Collect finish successfully even when the external call fails.
Weakened the Collect guard by changing >= to > for the MinSum check so calls at exactly MinSum no longer collect.
Weakened the Collect guard by changing >= to > for the amount check so collecting exactly the entire balance no longer succeeds.
Changed the balance deduction to addition so Collect credits the caller instead of debiting them before the external call.
Deleted the revert on failed external call so Collect completes even when the recipient rejects the transfer.
Moved the balance deduction to after the external call, enabling reentrant double-collect before the balance is reduced.
